mu-skill-creator v4.1.1 introduces major enhancements to audit rigor and documentation structure.

- 审计标准升级：全面推行“55项10层逐项确认”审计模型，脚本核验不再等同于全面审计，强调内容与自动核验必须并行。
- 新增阶段与流程规范：引入SSO认证方案及强制ICE-5闭环处理，完善安全与事故防御流程。
- 已知局限重构：明确“硬伤”标准，变更为三要素+分类条目，上限3条，强调必须给出降级路径。
- Gotchas与AP清单分层：主文件仅留结论和索引，详述及事故移入 references/，减少冗余信息与主文件负荷。
- 文件结构与安全规范细化：严格一跳引用，强化前置合规和安全审核机制。
- 附加图表素材和文档移除更新，提高可用性，优化

- Expanded documentation with detailed multi-stage skill creation and auditing workflow.
- Added explicit IRON LAW rules enforcing strict audit, context budgeting, and business-specific constraints.
- Introduced a three-layer model (L1/L2/L3) to control complexity and context use.
- Outlined clear division among related skills and included a comprehensive anti-pattern (AP) checklist.
- New sections cover design motivation, defensively- and constructively-oriented principles, security policies, and known limitations for improved quality gatekeeping.
